implementation.name: original-v1-benchmark-async-timing
implementation.scope: Original schematic host/accelerator timeline; no measured duration or speedup claim.
implementation.question: Why can a host call finish before the accelerator?

purpose: Follow one shared time cursor through host return, device-event boundaries, and synchronized host completion; observe each timer stop independently.
storyboard: Establish timing boundaries; enqueue and return; start device event; execute bracketed work; stop device event; observe host completion.
guard: Coordinates are from the original drawing, not measured durations. Device events cover only their stream positions, and earlier device work has completed before the host timer starts.
